invented.quote: A refrigerated van solves both halves of the problem. It lets us collect produce directly from farms at harvest and keep it at safe temperatures until it reaches families.
invented.why: The brief does not state that a refrigerated van can serve as cold storage to keep food at safe temperatures until distribution, nor that produce is collected specifically at harvest.

invented.quote: We are making this commitment because fresh food is the greatest unmet need we see.
invented.why: The brief does not state that fresh food is the greatest unmet need the food bank sees.

invented.quote: The Foundation's $12,000 grant in 2023 paid for shelving we use on every distribution day.
invented.why: The brief states the 2023 grant was for shelving, but does not say the shelving is used on every distribution day.
